supported: status
setup (TTY wizard + non-interactive flags/JSON; privacy defaults OFF)
login/logout
doctor (structured diagnostics; --json; network opt-in; local --repair-journal with explicit replay-risk flag)
lockdown (immediate local containment); unlock and token revoke (typed admin actions; fresh browser passkey approval)
no-argument TUI launch and completion generation (bash/zsh/fish/powershell/elvish)
config get/set/edit/validate (typed keys, atomic save, no secret fields)
instance add/list/use/remove (validated control-plane URLs)
device enroll/list/show/rename/labels/rotate-key/revoke
exec (local IPC or authenticated remote MCP; exact argv; explicit remote idempotency)
process start/status/logs/stop (bounded daemon-owned sessions, exact argv)
session list/show/open/attach/claim/release/give/close/terminate (generic exact program/args; local IPC; authenticated remote creation)
approval list/show/watch/approve/deny (typed decisions; fresh browser passkey for mutations; /approve inbox + batch set commitment; deny-all without passkey)
policy show/validate/explain/preset/rule mutation (typed admin actions; fresh browser passkey approval)
grants list/show/revoke/mint (bounded tool grants lift Ask only; mint is fresh-passkey admin; revoke/lockdown are local tightening)
transfer plan/send/list/status/cancel (authenticated control-plane MCP; destination replace only with overwrite_expected_sha256; no blind force; idempotency keys required for mutations)
mcp serve --stdio (authenticated configured issuer; bounded JSONL bridge)
service install/start/stop/restart/status/uninstall (user-level ownmeshd autostart only)
privileged broker install/status/uninstall (networkless native lifecycle: Linux systemd, macOS launchd, Windows SCM; native release receipts tracked separately)
update default/check/download/apply/status/channel (signed crash-safe self-update; network off by default)
workspace list/show/add/update/remove (device-local registry via ownmeshd IPC)

logs providers/query (authenticated local IPC; bounded, cursor-paged device log read across audit, journald, Docker/Podman, and process providers, plus Windows Event Log on Windows; no remote route and no remote log-body persistence)
notes: v1.2.26 surface contract. OwnMesh exposes generic exact-program command, process, PTY, and session capabilities; it does not ship first-class coding-agent profiles or vendor-specific adapters. External CLIs may be launched only through the same exact program/args, workspace, policy, approval, replay, and audit boundaries as any other executable. A workspace or cwd binding is not an operating-system sandbox. OwnMesh authorizes the external process/session boundary and does not observe or authorize vendor-internal tool actions. Legacy Profile RPC/session fields are rejected explicitly, and persisted Profile sessions are discarded rather than guessed into generic sessions. MCP catalog v2 records this intentional removal.
